# Mayo Clinic

> > Mayo Clinic is a world-leading nonprofit medical center providing patient care, health information, and specialized digital health programs.

Mayo Clinic operates hospitals and clinics in Arizona, Florida, Minnesota, and London, offering comprehensive medical services. The organization also provides digital health tools including the Mayo Clinic Diet program, Anxiety Coach for mental health support, and cancer education resources.

## Key Topics

- Mayo Clinic
- Mayo Clinic Anxiety Coach
- Mayo Clinic Diet
- Mediterranean diet
- DASH diet
- anxiety treatment
- OCD treatment
- exposure therapy
- weight loss programs
- meal plans
- cancer education
- family stress management
- GLP-1 medications
- dietary options

## Mental Health Programs

- [Mayo Clinic Anxiety Coach](https://anxietycoach.mayoclinic.org): Anxiety Coach homepage for child anxiety, OCD, depression treatment tools
- [Family Stress Resource Center](https://anxietycoach.mayoclinic.org/family-stress): Family stress management program for kids, teens dealing with change
- [Doing Exposure Therapy](https://anxietycoach.mayoclinic.org/anxiety/doing-exposures): Exposure therapy guide with fear ladder practice for anxiety treatment

## Diet & Nutrition Programs

- [Weight Loss Meal Plans](https://diet.mayoclinic.org/us/meal-plans): Mayo Clinic Diet meal plans featuring Simple, Mediterranean, keto diets

## Cancer Support Resources

- [Living with Cancer Guide](https://cancereducation.mayoclinic.org): Cancer symptom management guide covering pain, sleep, side effects

## Main Site

- [Mayo Clinic Homepage](https://mayoclinic.org): Mayo Clinic homepage with locations in Arizona, Florida, Minnesota, London
